description: One engine a worker runs: which it is, the jobs the worker claims to do with it, and where its provider is reached.

jobs.description: The jobs the worker claims to do with this engine, as a claim names them (`job:claim`'s `accepts`): it claims with these filters and no other.

baseUrl.description: The address the provider's API is reached at.

apiKeyEnv.description: The environment variable holding the provider's API key, when the provider requires one.
